minutes.headline: Committee reorganized, set finalist site-visit plans for the superintendent search, and approved facility rates and extended day fees.
minutes.summary: The School Committee reorganized for the year, heard the superintendent search process with three finalists and site-visit dates, and approved school improvement plans, handbooks and facility use rates. It also approved extended day fees, took first reading of policies, and went into executive session on union negotiations.

Approve the committee slate and organizational chart for 2018-2019
Waive first reading of listed policies
Approve extended day fees for fiscal years 19 through 21 and summer fees
Enter executive session to discuss strategy for negotiations with the Lunenburg Education Association

what_happened.line: The School Committee approved extended day fees for fiscal years 19 through 21, with summer moved to a straight hourly rate.
The committee accepted facility use rates effective July 1, 2018, a small increase over current fees.
The committee heard the superintendent search process, with three finalists and site-visit dates, and members were asked to send interview question topics by Monday.
The committee approved school improvement plans and handbook changes for Turkey Hill and the primary school, and kept existing policies in effect.
The superintendent was cleared to post five positions, including interim high school principal and athletic director; other positions stay frozen.

why_it_matters: Extended day fees are set for three years, so families using before- and after-school care and the summer program will see the stepped-up rates in each of those years.

The superintendent search finalists and site visits lead to a choice that will shape school leadership and budgets for years, and the hiring freeze on other positions affects what staffing the district can fill.
